backend.description: Embedding backend used to build the crawl's semantic space.
backend.title: Backend
backend.ui_effect: Switching backend changes every similarity score the crawl computes.

model_name.description: Model identifier passed to the embedding backend.
model_name.title: Model Name
model_name.ui_effect: A different model gives different vectors, so similarity scores shift.

flush_interval_seconds.description: Maximum time between semantic-space growth flushes.
flush_interval_seconds.title: Flush Interval Seconds
flush_interval_seconds.ui_effect: Longer waits let more scored links accumulate before the space learns from them; shorter updates it more often.

flush_threshold.description: Buffered scored-link count that triggers an early flush.
flush_threshold.title: Flush Threshold
flush_threshold.ui_effect: Lower flushes sooner when many links arrive quickly; higher lets the buffer grow between flushes.

buffer_max_size.description: Upper bound on the flush buffer before backpressure applies.
buffer_max_size.title: Buffer Max Size
buffer_max_size.ui_effect: When the buffer is full, the stage that feeds it waits instead of queuing more links.

batch_size.description: Number of transformed items grouped into one export batch.
batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.ui_effect: Larger batches mean fewer writes; smaller batches write more often.

FetchConfig.description:
Page fetching: politeness, backoff, timeouts and request headers
(pipelines/requests_pipeline.py, infrastructure/network_client.py).

min_delay.description: Minimum seconds between two requests (global, all workers).
min_delay.title: Min Delay
min_delay.ui_effect: The main politeness control: raising it slows every request the crawler makes, across all workers.

jitter_max.description: Random 0..N seconds added to every request delay.
jitter_max.title: Jitter Max
jitter_max.ui_effect: Adds a random pause up to this length to each request, so requests do not arrive on a fixed beat.

backoff_start.description: First backoff delay after a 429 response.
backoff_start.title: Backoff Start
backoff_start.ui_effect: Sets how long the crawler waits after the first 429 (too many requests) response from a site.

backoff_max.description: Upper bound for the shared 429 backoff.
backoff_max.title: Backoff Max
backoff_max.ui_effect: Caps how long the shared backoff can grow after repeated 429 responses.

backoff_growth.title: Backoff Growth
backoff_growth.ui_effect: Each further 429 multiplies the backoff by this, so higher values back off faster.

backoff_success_decay.description: Backoff multiplier after a successful fetch.
backoff_success_decay.title: Backoff Success Decay
backoff_success_decay.ui_effect: Each successful fetch multiplies the backoff by this; 1 keeps it unchanged, lower values restore speed faster.

backoff_failure_decay.description: Backoff multiplier after a non-429 failure.
backoff_failure_decay.title: Backoff Failure Decay
backoff_failure_decay.ui_effect: A failure that is not a 429 multiplies the backoff by this; lower values let a struggling site recover speed faster.

http_total_timeout.description: Whole-request timeout for page fetches and LLM calls.
http_total_timeout.title: Http Total Timeout
http_total_timeout.ui_effect: A page or LLM reply that takes longer than this counts as a failed request and is retried.

http_connect_timeout.title: Http Connect Timeout
http_connect_timeout.ui_effect: A host that does not accept the connection within this time counts as a failed request.

respect_robots.title: Respect Robots
respect_robots.ui_effect: On: pages a site disallows in robots.txt are skipped. Off: they are fetched anyway.

robots_ttl_seconds.description: Seconds a parsed robots.txt is kept; 0 keeps it for the whole crawl.
robots_ttl_seconds.title: Robots Ttl Seconds
robots_ttl_seconds.ui_effect: Longer keeps robots.txt rules longer before the file is fetched again.

user_agent.description: User-Agent header sent with every request.
user_agent.title: User Agent
user_agent.ui_effect: Sites read this name on every request, and some block agents they do not know; changing it changes how the crawler identifies itself.

accept.title: Accept
accept.ui_effect: Tells servers which content types to send; a different list can change which version of a page comes back.

accept_encoding.title: Accept Encoding
accept_encoding.ui_effect: Tells servers which compressions the crawler can read; removing one makes servers send pages uncompressed or with another method.

accept_language.title: Accept Language
accept_language.ui_effect: Asks sites for pages in this language when they offer several; empty lets each site choose.

extra_headers.description: Additional request headers; override the ones above on a name clash.
extra_headers.title: Extra Headers
extra_headers.ui_effect: Each header is sent on every request and replaces a default header of the same name.

max_response_bytes.description: Largest page body read, counted after decompression.
max_response_bytes.title: Max Response Bytes
max_response_bytes.ui_effect: A page or robots.txt larger than this is refused instead of read, which protects memory from huge or compressed-bomb responses.

allow_private_addresses.description: Fetch pages from private, loopback and link-local addresses.
allow_private_addresses.title: Allow Private Addresses
allow_private_addresses.ui_effect: Off: links to this machine, your local network or a cloud metadata address are refused. On: they are fetched, which only a crawl of your own test site needs.

FetchConfig.title: FetchConfig

LlmConfig.description: Request parameters shared by every LLM provider call.

max_calls_per_crawl.description: Total LLM calls one crawl may make; empty means no cap.
max_calls_per_crawl.title: Max Calls Per Crawl
max_calls_per_crawl.ui_effect: At the cap the crawl keeps going, but links the LLM would have judged are scored on NLP alone.

max_tokens.description: Completion token cap; empty uses the provider default.
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.ui_effect: Caps how long each LLM reply can be; a cap that is too low cuts replies short.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; empty uses the provider default.
temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.ui_effect: Higher values make the LLM's judgements vary more between calls; lower values make them more repeatable.

key_cooldown_seconds.description: Minimum gap before the same API key is reused.
key_cooldown_seconds.title: Key Cooldown Seconds
key_cooldown_seconds.ui_effect: After a key is used it waits this long before it is used again, which spreads requests across keys.

LlmConfig.title: LlmConfig

composite_weights.description: Feature weights of the composite NLP score (negative subtracts).
composite_weights.title: Composite Weights
composite_weights.ui_effect: Raising a feature's weight adds more of it to the NLP score; a negative weight lowers the score.

target_top_k.description: Nearest target-basis vectors averaged into target similarity.
target_top_k.title: Target Top K
target_top_k.ui_effect: Averages more reference vectors into each link's topic similarity, so one odd reference counts for less.

cluster_eps.description: DBSCAN cosine radius used to find clusters in the semantic space.
cluster_eps.title: Cluster Eps
cluster_eps.ui_effect: A larger radius groups looser neighbours into one cluster, so fewer pages count as new.

cluster_min_samples.title: Cluster Min Samples
cluster_min_samples.ui_effect: Higher values need more similar pages before a cluster forms, so fewer clusters are found.

link_context_length.description: Characters of surrounding text kept as a link's context.
link_context_length.title: Link Context Length
link_context_length.ui_effect: More surrounding text gives each link more to score on, and costs more time and tokens.

debug_enabled.description: Write the per-crawl debug trace file.
debug_enabled.title: Debug Enabled
debug_enabled.ui_effect: On writes a detailed trace file for each crawl, which takes disk space.

ui_port.description: Websocket port the live graph connects to.
ui_port.title: Ui Port
ui_port.ui_effect: Changing it means the live graph page has to connect to the new port.

snapshot_max_candidates.description: Scoring decisions kept for the live view.
snapshot_max_candidates.title: Snapshot Max Candidates
snapshot_max_candidates.ui_effect: Caps how many scoring decisions the live view can show; older ones are dropped.

snapshot_max_errors.description: Crawl errors kept for the live view.
snapshot_max_errors.title: Snapshot Max Errors
snapshot_max_errors.ui_effect: Caps how many crawl errors the live view keeps; older ones are dropped.

PipelineSettings.description: Worker count and queue bound of one pipeline.

workers.title: Workers
workers.ui_effect: More workers drain this stage's queue faster, so the crawl moves faster, but more work is held in memory at once and more calls go out in parallel.

max_queue_size.title: Max Queue Size
max_queue_size.ui_effect: Caps how much work waits for this stage. Once it is full, the stage before it waits, so memory stays flat and the crawl slows. Empty lets memory grow without limit.

PipelineSettings.title: PipelineSettings

PipelinesConfig.description:
Per-pipeline parallelism (core/crawler.py:_build_pipelines). Logging
and canonicalization stay single-worker so output order is preserved.
PipelinesConfig.title: PipelinesConfig

PriorityConfig.description: Mix of NLP and LLM scores in a link's priority (priority_pipeline.py).

nlp_bias.description: Weight of the NLP score in a link's priority; only its ratio to llm_bias matters.
nlp_bias.title: Nlp Bias
nlp_bias.ui_effect: Raising it lets the cheap similarity score move links up the queue more; only its ratio to the LLM weight matters.

llm_bias.description: Weight of the LLM score in a link's priority; only its ratio to nlp_bias matters.
llm_bias.title: Llm Bias
llm_bias.ui_effect: Raising it lets the LLM's judgement move links up the queue more; only its ratio to the NLP weight matters.

aggressive_weights.description: Feature weights of the 'aggressive' priority strategy; depth_penalty is subtracted per level of depth.
aggressive_weights.title: Aggressive Weights
aggressive_weights.ui_effect: Raising one feature's weight ranks links with more of it higher. Raising all of them together makes the NLP part count for more against the LLM score.

balanced_weights.description: Feature weights of the 'balanced' priority strategy; depth_penalty is subtracted per level of depth.
balanced_weights.title: Balanced Weights
balanced_weights.ui_effect: Raising one feature's weight ranks links with more of it higher. Raising all of them together makes the NLP part count for more against the LLM score.

exploration_weights.description: Feature weights of the 'exploration' priority strategy; depth_penalty is subtracted per level of depth.
exploration_weights.title: Exploration Weights
exploration_weights.ui_effect: Raising one feature's weight ranks links with more of it higher. Raising all of them together makes the NLP part count for more against the LLM score.

PriorityConfig.title: PriorityConfig

PromptsConfig.description:
Wording of the scoring prompt (models/prompts.py). The output format
and JSON constraints are fixed because the response parser depends on
them.

scoring_system.default:
You are a semantic relevance scoring engine for a focused web crawler.

Your job is to evaluate candidate links and assign:
- a relevance score (0 to 100)
- a relevance type
- optional semantic expansions

Return ONLY valid JSON.
No markdown.
No explanation outside JSON.
scoring_system.description: System prompt of the link-scoring LLM call.
scoring_system.title: Scoring System
scoring_system.ui_effect: Changes the instructions the LLM follows on every scoring call; the output format stays fixed so replies still parse.

scoring_rules.default:
RULES:
- Each candidate URL is independent
- Use strategy_context as soft bias only
- Score range: integer 0–100
- Assign exactly one relevance_type:
  direct | partial | irrelevant | ambiguous
- Generate 2–4 semantic expansions per link
- Expansions must be conceptual, not copied text
scoring_rules.description: RULES block of the scoring prompt.
scoring_rules.title: Scoring Rules
scoring_rules.ui_effect: Changes the rules the LLM applies when it judges links, on every call.

strategy_contexts.description: Wording that biases the scoring LLM, per scoring strategy.
strategy_contexts.title: Strategy Contexts
strategy_contexts.ui_effect: Each line tilts the LLM toward that strategy's goal, so changing it shifts which links score high.

PromptsConfig.title: PromptsConfig

ProvidersConfig.description:
Request URL per LLM provider (config/config.py). Point a
provider at any compatible server; Gemini takes a base URL.

endpoints.description: Request URL used for each provider.
endpoints.title: Endpoints
endpoints.ui_effect: Changing a URL sends that provider's requests to another server, such as a local or compatible one.

ProvidersConfig.title: ProvidersConfig

max_request_retries.description: Requeues of a node after failed fetches.
max_request_retries.title: Max Request Retries
max_request_retries.ui_effect: A page that fails to fetch is requeued this many times before the crawler gives up on it. Each retry sends another request to the site, so a failing site gets more load.

max_scoring_retries.description: Reschedules of a node after failed scoring.
max_scoring_retries.title: Max Scoring Retries
max_scoring_retries.ui_effect: A page whose scoring fails is rescheduled this many times before the crawler gives up on it. Each reschedule sends the LLM call again, so it spends LLM calls and budget.

base_delay.description: First retry delay; grows by `growth` each attempt.
base_delay.title: Base Delay
base_delay.ui_effect: The wait before the first retry; later retries wait longer by the growth multiplier.

growth.title: Growth
growth.ui_effect: Multiplies the retry wait on each attempt; 1 waits the same time every attempt.

empty_score_demotion.description: Places a page later in the queue when its LLM result was empty.
empty_score_demotion.title: Empty Score Demotion
empty_score_demotion.ui_effect: Lowers the page's place in the queue by this many priority points when its LLM result came back empty, so it is crawled later.

fetch_retry_demotion.description: Places a page later in the queue on each fetch retry.
fetch_retry_demotion.title: Fetch Retry Demotion
fetch_retry_demotion.ui_effect: Lowers the page's place in the queue by this many priority points on every fetch retry, so failing pages are tried later.

seed.description: Seed for every random stream; empty is unseeded.
seed.title: Seed
seed.ui_effect: A fixed seed makes every random choice repeat, so two runs with the same settings sample the same links.

stop_check_interval.description: Seconds between stop-condition checks on a quiet crawl.
stop_check_interval.title: Stop Check Interval
stop_check_interval.ui_effect: Shorter checks stop a quiet crawl sooner but use a little more CPU.

shutdown_grace.description: Seconds the other tasks get to finish once a crawl stops.
shutdown_grace.title: Shutdown Grace
shutdown_grace.ui_effect: Longer gives in-flight work more time to finish before the crawl stops; shorter stops sooner.

ScoringCascadeConfig.description:
The two-stage NLP -> LLM relevance cascade's tunable thresholds and
sampling fractions (report section 0.13, "Evaluation multi-etapes").

percentile_bucketing.description: Bucket links by per-node score percentile instead of the absolute thresholds.
percentile_bucketing.title: Percentile Bucketing
percentile_bucketing.ui_effect: Percentiles judge each link against its own page; fixed cut-offs judge every link against the same scale.

low_threshold.description: NLP similarity score below which a link is considered low-confidence.
low_threshold.title: Low Threshold
low_threshold.ui_effect: Raising it moves more links into the low-confidence bucket, where most are dropped.

high_threshold.description: NLP similarity score above which a link is considered high-confidence.
high_threshold.title: High Threshold
high_threshold.ui_effect: Lowering it moves more links into the high-confidence bucket, which the LLM judges less often.

high_score_llm_fraction.description: Fraction of the high-confidence bucket still sent to the LLM rather than trusted outright.
high_score_llm_fraction.title: High Score Llm Fraction
high_score_llm_fraction.ui_effect: Lowering it saves LLM calls; raising it checks more of the high bucket with the LLM.

high_score_random_fraction.description: Of the LLM-bound slice of the high bucket, the fraction chosen at random rather than by top NLP rank.
high_score_random_fraction.title: High Score Random Fraction
high_score_random_fraction.ui_effect: Raising it checks more random high-bucket links, which corrects bias from always taking the top-ranked ones.

low_score_sample_fraction.description: Fraction of the low-confidence bucket kept anyway, for exploration, instead of dropped outright.
low_score_sample_fraction.title: Low Score Sample Fraction
low_score_sample_fraction.ui_effect: Raising it keeps more doubtful links for the LLM, so the crawl explores more and spends more calls.

default_priority_strategy.description: Priority strategy used when a blueprint doesn't specify one.
default_priority_strategy.title: Default Priority Strategy
default_priority_strategy.ui_effect: Sets how the queue is ordered when a blueprint does not pick a strategy. Chosen with the cards above the weights.

low_percentile.description: Percentile below which a link falls in the low bucket.
low_percentile.title: Low Percentile
low_percentile.ui_effect: Raising it sends fewer links to the low bucket, so fewer are dropped outright.

high_percentile.description: Percentile above which a link falls in the high bucket.
high_percentile.title: High Percentile
high_percentile.ui_effect: Lowering it sends more links to the high bucket, which the LLM judges less often.

percentile_min_links.description: Fewer links than this on a page fall back to the absolute thresholds.
percentile_min_links.title: Percentile Min Links
percentile_min_links.ui_effect: Raising it makes small pages use the fixed cut-offs instead of percentiles.

max_llm_links_per_node.description: Hard cap on links sent to the LLM for one page.
max_llm_links_per_node.title: Max Llm Links Per Node
max_llm_links_per_node.ui_effect: Caps the LLM work of any single page; links above the cap are not judged by the LLM.

llm_batch_size.description: Links per LLM call; empty sends all of a page's links in one call.
llm_batch_size.title: Llm Batch Size
llm_batch_size.ui_effect: Smaller batches make more calls with shorter prompts; larger batches make fewer calls.

ScoringCascadeConfig.title: ScoringCascadeConfig

UrlConfig.description:
Node identity rules (utils/html_utils.py:normalize_url). Changing them
changes which links count as the same page.

strip_fragment.title: Strip Fragment
strip_fragment.ui_effect: On: links that differ only after # count as one page. Off: each anchor is crawled as its own page.

strip_trailing_slash.title: Strip Trailing Slash
strip_trailing_slash.ui_effect: On: a trailing slash does not make a new page. Off: /page and /page/ are crawled separately.

UrlConfig.title: UrlConfig

description:
Top-level runtime configuration: everything a researcher would want
to see before trusting a crawl's results, beyond the per-run blueprint
(target topic, seeds, extraction schema) already covered by
config/blueprint_schema.py.
title: RuntimeConfig

ui_glossary.429: The HTTP status 'too many requests': the site asks the crawler to slow down.
ui_glossary.backoff: The pause the crawler takes after a site answers with too many requests (429), growing with each one.
ui_glossary.backoff decay: How much each successful fetch shrinks the backoff pause (0.5 halves it). Example: a 4 s pause becomes 2 s after one success.
ui_glossary.backpressure: A full queue or buffer making the stage before it wait, so that memory does not grow without limit.
ui_glossary.best-ranked: The rest of the LLM-bound high-confidence links, taken in NLP rank order. Example: with a 0.5 random fraction, the other half are the top-ranked links.
ui_glossary.blueprint: A saved description of one crawl: its target, seeds, scoring focus and extraction schema.
ui_glossary.bucket: A group of links that the cascade treats the same way: dropped, kept to explore, sent to the LLM, or trusted on the NLP score.
ui_glossary.cascade: The two-stage filter: a cheap NLP score settles most links, and only the uncertain ones go to the LLM.
ui_glossary.cascade replay: The cascade run again from its saved LLM answers; no live LLM calls are made.
ui_glossary.cosine: A measure of how closely two embeddings point the same way; 1 is identical direction, 0 is unrelated.
ui_glossary.coverage gap: A priority bonus for a topic region the crawl has barely visited. Example: 40 bread pages and no flour page, so flour pages get the boost.
ui_glossary.dbscan: A clustering method that groups points lying close together and leaves isolated ones out.
ui_glossary.debug trace: A log of each decision the crawler made for a page, which can include link text. It is written only while debugging is on.
ui_glossary.demotion: Lowering a page's priority so it is crawled later.
ui_glossary.embedding: A list of numbers that stands for a text's meaning, so that similar texts get similar numbers.
ui_glossary.flush: Writing the buffered work out at once, instead of waiting for the next scheduled write.
ui_glossary.harvest: The share of the first k fetched pages that are relevant; harvest@k is that share over the first k fetches.
ui_glossary.high-confidence bucket: The links the NLP score rates above the high cut-off. Only a share of them goes to the LLM; the rest is trusted.
ui_glossary.in flight: Requests that have been sent and not yet answered. The number of workers caps it.
ui_glossary.jitter: A random extra pause added to each delay so that requests do not arrive on a fixed rhythm.
ui_glossary.key cooldown: Minimum gap before the same API key is reused. Example: at 2 s, one key sends at most one request every 2 s and a second key takes the next.
ui_glossary.llm bias: The share of a link's priority that comes from the LLM's judgement. Only its ratio to the NLP bias matters.
ui_glossary.llm score: A relevance judgement from the language model, which costs a request per batch of links.
ui_glossary.llm_all: Baseline that asks the LLM about every candidate link, instead of letting the NLP score choose which to ask.
ui_glossary.middle band: The links between the two cut-offs. Every one of them goes to the LLM. Raise the low cut-off or lower the high one to shrink it.
ui_glossary.nlp bias: The share of a link's priority that comes from its NLP score. Only its ratio to the LLM bias matters.
ui_glossary.nlp score: A fast similarity score computed locally from the link's text and its context, with no LLM call.
ui_glossary.no_llm: Baseline that replays the cascade's expansion without calling the LLM, so it shows what the NLP side does alone.
ui_glossary.novelty injection: A priority bonus for pages unlike those already seen. Example: after ten bread recipes, a page about bread ovens ranks higher.
ui_glossary.percentile: A link's place in its own page's scores: 90 % means it scores higher than 90 % of that page's links.
ui_glossary.percentile bucketing: Splitting a page's links by their place in that page's own scores, instead of by fixed cut-offs, so every page has links in every band.
ui_glossary.politeness: How gently the crawler treats a site: the pause between requests, how many run at once, and how much a site's refusals slow it.
ui_glossary.priority: A page's place in the queue; higher priority is crawled sooner.
ui_glossary.priority points: The units of a link's priority score, where higher is crawled sooner. A demotion subtracts points, so the page waits longer in the queue.
ui_glossary.queue: The line of work waiting for a pipeline stage to pick it up.
ui_glossary.queue bound: The most items a stage's queue may hold. When it is full, the stage before it waits.
ui_glossary.random fraction: Of the high-confidence links sent to the LLM, the share picked at random rather than by NLP rank. Example: at 0.5, half are a random draw.
ui_glossary.requeue: Putting a page back in the queue to be tried again later.
ui_glossary.robots.txt: A file where a site states which pages automated crawlers may fetch.
ui_glossary.seed: The number that starts a random sequence; the same seed gives the same random choices.
ui_glossary.semantic delta: How far a page's meaning moves from the page that linked to it. Example: a shop's contact page differs from its bread parent page.
ui_glossary.temperature: How much randomness the LLM uses when it picks its reply; 0 is the most repeatable.
ui_glossary.template: A saved blueprint for one kind of crawl. It fixes the target, the seeds and the scoring focus the crawl starts with.
ui_glossary.token: The unit an LLM reads and bills: about four characters of English text.
ui_glossary.tokens: The units an LLM reads and bills: about four characters of English text each. The cost readouts estimate them from the prompt and link text.
ui_glossary.top-k: Keeping only the k best matches, here the k closest reference vectors to a link.
ui_glossary.user-agent: The name a crawler sends with each request so that a site knows who is asking.
ui_glossary.worker: One of the parallel loops that take items from a stage's queue and process them.
